visual.detail: Manager must inspect all views for placement, proportions, missing/extra parts and visible intersections
visual.observation: Inspected the front, top and isometric views of this round; they are byte-identical to the renders inspected before the last source change, which touched only Saturn's ring. Sol Neptune: one Ø33.87 disc whose wall flares outward as it rises, one Ø21.89 globe standing on its own seat collar, total height 24.89 mm. Proportions match the rank-5 row of the ladder. The surface markings and the rank numeral are flush colour inlays, so they carry no silhouette in a single-colour render and were checked by measurement instead; the assembly render shows them in their own filaments. No missing, extra, misplaced or intersecting geometry, no floating body, correct orientation.
